study: Visible transverse landmark correspondence and amodal width intervals
cohort: All 416 distinct physical frames in the sealed C_E_Qsize confirmation. The 288 ordinary Validation frames and 224 recording-separated frames overlap. Ordinary data have been exposed. Keep the 96 upstream fallbacks and all failed landmark or geometry reads.
method_lock: Use the exact H output and the full selected region from the prior seal. Canonical width is the shorter horizontal axis, length is the longer. Only the predicted center along that width axis may move. Existing dimensions are a plug-in width and are not guaranteed to cover the true extent. No threshold, prompt or platform selection on scores.
oracle: Diagnostic only, in a separate label-reading executable. Maximize exact oriented IoU over one transverse translation for each non-null H. Find the extrema of the piecewise quadratic intersection volume; check by an independent numerical calculation. Report aggregate headroom first. Per-frame oracle data never enter prediction, the inspection panel or model calls. If there are no eligible selected-region failures recoverable at .50, stop before model inference.
rgb: One frozen Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct call per used region on its original RGB crop with 12.5 percent padding on each side of the frozen rectangle. No captions, coordinates from LiDAR, annotations or task scores supplied. Identify the same visible subfeature on each side of one rigid vehicle front or rear, ordered by image x. Headlamp outer tips first, then taillamp outer tips, then a pair of lateral bumper corners. No mirrors or hidden parts. Optional different visible part on each side for same-vehicle wrong correspondence. Greedy bfloat16 SDPA, max 128 output tokens, batch four, max 524288 image pixels; same pinned model and processor assets.
association: Use nearest depth per historical 4x4 native pixel cell, full-tree membership by original transfer. Fit anchor is nearest such return in a non-held cell within 4 native pixels of a named endpoint; choose smaller pixel error when both qualify, independent of oracle or predicted IoU. Opposite end never used to pick an anchor. Keep opposite held-cell return separate for diagnostics and flag if sampled by the frozen tree. Report both all withheld-by-readout and strict unsampled, held-cell witnesses. The source tree may have used other pixels in the same frame.
geometry: Rebuild the full selected region and verify identity. Project previous measured region support onto canonical width n. Read a raw anchor p at a named pixel and add it to the same support in all paired arms. Intersect frozen width containment intervals. New endpoint uses closest transverse-line to camera-ray solution; positive depth, projected point within 4 native pixels, finite solution, sign-independent. For triangulation use the set of shifts consistent with a plus/minus 4 native pixel footprint (undistorted rectangular envelope) and |s|<=W; add the corresponding interval of possible endpoint positions conservatively. Infeasible or unconstrained evidence falls back to the same measured-only result. Report the uninflated point estimate as a diagnostic. No new shape primitive.
controls: H: frozen C_E_Qsize; real: measured selected region; anchor: real plus the same measured landmark; copy: the opposite image pixel assigned anchor optical z with the same pixel uncertainty; pair: transverse-line inference; wrong: use the original anchor and a different annotated feature on the same target side with the identical solver. If wrong unavailable leave measured fallback, report common availability separately. No ground truth to select or accept responses.
visual_audit: Blind visual review, separate from task outcomes. Select up to eight full-region frames per platform by round-robin recording and hash. The analyst sees frozen target crops first, records pair visibility and unknowns without Qwen or oracle, then compares actual landmarks. No claim of human annotation. Also audit all actual paired-center changes against controls after sealing. When both ends have returns, compare predicted opposite depth with a reserved frontmost return, reporting sampling overlap and failure to establish instance identity.
metrics: Strict >.25, >.50, mIoU; equal target weighting. All, Validation, recording-separated, extension and per platform; rescue/harm and center distances, original support span, positive incremental span, excluded center, intersection with oracle-recoverable frames, per-record effects. No independent-test claim. Preserve all rows and negative cases.
decision: Keep C_E_Qsize unless the new information actually yields positioning and task gains versus the matched measured-only and copied-depth controls. Distinguish insufficient eligible coverage from evidence that the geometry is wrong.
